pr_title: Support importing connections from files with ".yml" extension
pr_body:
Closes #22473

This PR adds support for importing connections from files with the `.yml` extension. #22473 also describes adding the option to _export_ connections to `.yml` files. I decided to skip this out of consideration for the robustness principle (be conservative about output, be liberal about input).
pr_comments: @dstandish @kaxil @potiuk @ashb Please review this PR at your earliest convenience.

issue_context.title: Connections import and export should also support ".yml" file extensions
issue_context.body:
### Apache Airflow version

2.2.4 (latest released)

### What happened

Trying to export or import a yaml formatted connections file with ".yml" extension fails. 

### What you think should happen instead

While the "official recommended extension" for YAML files is .yaml, many pipeline are built around using the .yml file extension. Importing and exporting of .yml files should also be supported. 

### How to reproduce

Running airflow connections import or export with a file having a .yml file extension errors with:
`Unsupported file format. The file must have the extension .env or .json or .yaml`

debian 10 buster
